title: E-commerce Platform Incident Response
description: E-commerce platform incidents affecting online sales
immediate_actions: Assess impact on online sales and customer experience
Implement maintenance page if platform unavailable
Activate customer service team for order inquiries
investigation_steps: Check web server and application server status
Analyze web traffic patterns for anomalies
resolution_steps: Restart e-commerce platform services following standard procedures
Implement database fixes or restart if needed
Apply platform patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with third-party services (payment gateways, CDNs)
special_considerations: Coordinate with customer service for order inquiries
Document any orders that may have been affected
